title: Port mimid-server to the crate-jmap 0.4 API
description: Mark 2026-10-22: mimid-server's crate-jmap deps (jmap-chat-types, jmap-server) were declared branch = "main" while Cargo.lock pinned rev b8b6f251, so manifest and lock disagreed (cargo --locked failed at HEAD 385bf02) and any build silently moved to crate-jmap main. For the openmls 0.9.2 security bump (mimid-qcja) they are now pinned to rev b8b6f251 explicitly. crate-jmap main (ce742e06 as of 2026-10-22) carries the 0.4 breaking changes: typed SetErrorType/MethodErrorType, CallContext, PartialObject/CopyResponse returns, private modules (one public path), full Filter<C> trees on /query, typed comparators, blocked-sender hook shapes, etc. See crate-jmap CHANGELOG [Unreleased]. Work: move the pin to the 0.4 release (or a main rev), fix mimid-server compile errors against the new API, run mimid CI. Consider adding --locked to mimid CI so manifest/lock drift fails loudly.
notes: 2026-11-02: mimid-xxu3 closed (lock consistent at rev b8b6f251); CI still does not pass --locked.
